routeMetric: per segment: 1 ground lane length (blocks add up and down), 2 span from the first left edge to the last right edge, 3/4/5 centre-to-centre with mover paths end to end; jumps between segments are not counted
jumpModel: 80% jump = 80% initial speed (apex 0.88), flat reach 3.91, rises <= 0.8

cycle.clock: one shared area clock; epoch resets when the player enters the segment
cycle.invariant: damage active implies blink visible; blink hidden implies damage inactive; hide-blink after damage off, enable-damage after blink solid

implementationDependencies: PlatformCycleManager + externally controlled DamageFoothold / BlinkingFoothold (2-1 design items 1-4); the same shared clock serves segment 2 and the fusion pair
DeployStage51 must create Blinking platforms and the arrow traps; Stage5 theme trap prefabs exist (Trap/Themed/Stage5_DemonCastle)
monsters and item drops are not part of this revision
